in_sanskrit.name: जयकीर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Jakir is derived from the Sanskrit words 'जय' (jaya) meaning victory and 'कीर' (kira) meaning flame, thus it means 'Victory flame'. This name is bestowed upon a child born during a time of triumph and hope.

in_hindi.name: जकीर
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Jakir in Hindi is derived from the words 'जय' (jaya) meaning victory and 'कीर' (kira) meaning wealth or resource, thus it means 'Victory's wealth' or 'Resource born of victory'. This name is suitable for a child born into a victorious family or during a time of prosperity and success.

in_tamil.name: ஜகிர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Jakir in Tamil is derived from the words 'ஜயம்' (jayam) meaning victory and 'அருகில்' (arugil) meaning power or strength, thus it means 'Victory's power' or 'Power born of victory'. This name is suitable for a child born into a victorious family or during a time of strength and power.

in_telugu.name: జకిర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Jakir in Telugu is derived from the words 'జైయేశ్' (jayesh) meaning victory and 'పౌరుజేశ్' (paurujesh) meaning ruler or king, thus it means 'Victory's ruler' or 'King born of victory'. This name is suitable for a child born into a victorious family or during a time of leadership and power.

in_marathi.name: Jakir
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jakir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jakir is a name of God in Hinduism, it represents the divine power and strength. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jayati' meaning 'he conquers'.
